name: Széchenyi István University
summary: Győr university with sixteen English-taught bachelor's degrees across engineering, agriculture, business, social science and health.

ib.text: No IB points rule: upload your IB results and course list, notarised or apostilled. English: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 66, or proof your schooling was in English; otherwise a language interview.

programmes.name: Vehicle Engineering
programmes.about: Design, manufacture, operation, maintenance and diagnostics of vehicles and mobile machines, with safety, environmental protection and energy economy in view (210 credits).

needs.note: Evidence of studying Maths, from your final school results, is required

programmes.selectionNote: Faculty reviews your school results and course list; a language interview follows if your English proof falls short. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.ib: Motor ability tests submitted on video (swimming 200 m, 20 m shuttle run) and a medical fitness document with ECG and blood pressure results.
programmes.selectionNote: School results plus motor ability tests sent as video: 200 m swim, 20 m shuttle run (60 for men, 50 for women). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: SZE shows one tuition fee per programme and no separate EU price: EUR 2,600 a semester for engineering and IT, EUR 1,700 for the rest; the first two semesters plus a EUR 130 accommodation fee are paid before admission.
Every school document needs notarisation by the foreign ministry even when in English, or an apostille if your country is in the Hague Convention; the application fee is EUR 100.
The university decides whether to start each programme depending on how many qualified applicants there are.
